'''Lanzarota Malco''' was a [[Gender|female]] [[human]] who lived on [[Savareen]] in the [[Pnakotic Coast village]] on the [[Pnakotic Coast]]. Her tongue was removed during a raid of the [[Crimson Dawn]] because her [[Pnakotic Coast village|village]] tried to rise up against this criminal syndicate.<ref name="Solo: A Star Wars Story">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> She was responsible for supplying the village with energy and fresh [[water]], which is why she supervised the maintenance of [[wind turbine]]s and desalination [[Moisture vaporator|vaporators]].<ref name="TOG" /> She was also present when [[Tobias Beckett]]'s [[Beckett's gang|crew]] came to Savareen in [[10 BBY]] to refine [[Coaxium]] that they had stolen from [[Kessel]].<ref>''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' dates the events on [[Savareen]] in [[Solo: A Star Wars Story]] to nine years after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the formation of the Empire to [[19 BBY]], therefore the event on Savareen in Solo must take place in [[10 BBY]].</ref>
